decisions.reason: The firm has given this navigation and observation camera its own web page, it sits close to the core offer, and the development and space-qualification investment is large, so writing it off after one year would be hard to justify.
The modular navigation camera fits the announced push toward flexible, compact sensors for smaller satellites, and its own product page signals a public commitment that management will defend.

The situational awareness suite extends beyond the established offer and its market is still forming, but it is visibly presented and any slow early uptake can be put down to long space procurement cycles.

Public commitment is weaker because the LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, but it is central to the firm's miniaturization and docking direction, and the qualification effort already sunk argues for keeping it.
